name: billion-context
description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens), small context windows (a 100K context is enough), and token savings (5x fewer tokens).
one_liner: A plugin that compresses an AI coding assistant's long conversation history so it can keep working for weeks without losing earlier context or burning through its token budget.
buyer: An AI-dev agency running long, autonomous coding-agent sessions for clients who wants to cut the API token bill those month-long sessions rack up.
business_use_cases: An AI-dev agency uses it to make month-long autonomous builds for clients economically viable by cutting token costs.
A hosted 'AI coding agent as a service' platform integrates it to lower its own infrastructure costs and pass savings to customers.
A consultant sells a short 'tune your AI agent's context management' audit to teams running expensive, long-lived agent sessions.

money_ideas.idea: Cost-reduction audit for teams running long AI-agent sessions
Pass-through cost savings on a managed-agent hosting subscription

steal_this: Package this as a drop-in cost-reduction add-on for any team running Claude Code or Codex on long sessions, and sell a quick 'cut your agent's token bill' audit this weekend.
